reason: The method has a cyclomatic complexity of 17, 87 LOC, and accesses protected members while catching a broad Exception, all of which increase the risk of subtle bugs and make future maintenance difficult. It is part of the core click library and is invoked during command parsing, so defects here can affect many downstream users. Refactoring will reduce complexity, improve testability, and eliminate risky patterns.
action: Refactor handle_parse_result into smaller, focused helper methods: extract deprecation warning logic, type processing, and arbitration into separate functions; replace the broad Exception catch with specific exceptions (e.g., ValueError, TypeError) raised by process_value; eliminate direct access to ctx._param_default_explicit by providing a public accessor or moving the logic into the context class. This will lower cyclomatic complexity, improve clarity, and reduce hidden dependencies.
